name: Border Crossings
summary: At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister sends you to intercept Dalaran's supplies and learn why the Kirin Tor support Ambermill. The crates travel through Silverpine Forest toward a Dalaran camp near Pyrewood Village.

sections.title: Supplies on the Frontier
sections.body: Dalaran magi send wagons of supplies and arcane goods from the Hillsbrad Foothills through Silverpine Forest. Their shipments support outposts and staging grounds along the way. A camp just north of Pyrewood Village holds Dalaran personnel who watch the road. The human resistance at Ambermill is the main surviving stronghold in eastern Silverpine, and Dalaran has not left it to fend for itself.

sections.title: The Forsaken's Suspicion
sections.body: Shadow Priest Allister and the Forsaken leaders at the Sepulcher want to know why Dalaran commits so much to Ambermill. They suspect the Kirin Tor would not risk lives and supplies deep in Forsaken territory merely for a provincial town. A greater strategic or magical purpose may lie behind that support. Intercepting the crates can show the Forsaken what Dalaran is sending west.

sections.title: Uncovering the Cargo
sections.body: The crate Allister asks you to retrieve holds more than provisions. Inside are aged maps of Silverpine Forest and western Lordaeron, along with a magical pendant. The cargo includes arcane items and maps, but its purpose remains unclear.

faq.q: Why are Dalaran wizards active in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Dalaran works from Ambermill to maintain a human and Alliance presence in western Lordaeron. Shadow Priest Allister suspects the Kirin Tor have a deeper purpose than defending a rural hamlet, so the Forsaken target their supply lines.

faq.q: Where are the Dalaran crates located?
faq.answer: The crates are at a Dalaran camp just north of Pyrewood Village, off the main road. Dalaran magi and guards keep watch there.

faq.q: What is inside the Dalaran crate?
faq.answer: Allister does not know what Dalaran is shipping. He asks you to bring back the contents of a crate from the camp north of Pyrewood Village so he can investigate.
Shadow Priest Allister is a prominent Forsaken leader at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He directs intelligence efforts and strikes against human holdouts and Dalaran's incursions.

faq.q: How are the supplies getting into Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Wagons carry the shipments from Dalaran's territory in the Hillsbrad Foothills through the border pass into Silverpine. They then reach staging camps near Ambermill and Pyrewood.

faq.q: What follows the completion of this quest?
faq.answer: After inspecting the crate, take what you discover to Shadow Priest Allister for study in Maps and Runes.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know the Forsaken cannot tolerate an unchecked Dalaran outpost on their southern flank, especially one sending supplies under the Sepulcher's nose.
As a Forsaken priest, you help secure the domain of the Forsaken priesthood under Shadow Priest Allister against holy and arcane rivals.
As a Horde spellcaster, you share an interest in Dalaran's magical shipments and what they may reveal about the Kirin Tor's secrets and protective wards in Lordaeron.
